text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The race is starting shortly. This feeling 
of exhilaration never gets old, no matter 
how many times I experience it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My last race was a disappointing result, 
but I'm not letting it weigh on me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've done everything I could possibly do. 
All that's left now is to give it my all.
choice_data_list: Go out there and crush it.
Go and give it your all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall be on my way. I will see you 
again after the race.
